input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
在古代，很多医生不知道怎么用药。所以他们找到了很多植物对药。神农先看到很多病人，他们吃很多植物对药。但是我觉得他们的吃的植物，让他们病人。神农觉得这个植物可能特别是毒。所以他想找一个植物对药，他们可以吃对药。正好，他找到了一把花，他想把花放在茶里，对药。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 所以他们找到了很多植物对药：来做药
- 神农先看到很多病人，他们吃很多植物对药：better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears；吃了很多植物，了completed
- 但是我觉得他们的吃的植物，让他们病人：他们吃的植物让他们生病，让Sb. + V./Adj.
- 神农觉得这个植物可能特别是毒：可能毒性特别强，”特别是+N, + Clause” is used to single out a typical example
- 所以他想找一个植物对药，他们可以吃对药：找一个可以做药的植物；这样，他们可以……
- 他想把花放在茶里，对药：做成药

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 很多植物对药：很多能做药的植物，The modifier needs to describe what the plants can do. “能做药的植物” means plants that can be used as medicine; “对药” is not a valid expression here. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 植物对药：能做药的植物，Use “能做药的植物” to describe plants used as medicine; “对药” cannot follow a noun as its modifier. [rule: none]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 他们的吃的植物：他们吃的植物，The first “的” incorrectly makes the pronoun possessive. In a relative clause, the pronoun should directly be the subject of the action before “的”. [rule: redundancy_delete]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 让他们病人：让他们生病，After “让”, the result must be a verb phrase. “病人” is a noun meaning a sick person, while “生病” is the verb needed here. [rule: word_class_misuse]
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 特别是毒：特别有毒，“有毒” is the correct adjective phrase meaning poisonous. “是毒” cannot describe a plant in this way. [vocab list]
6. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一个植物对药，他们可以吃对药：一种可以做药、他们可以吃的植物，“种” is the suitable measure word for a type of plant. Both descriptions must come before the noun, and “对药” is not a valid expression for “can be used as medicine”. [rule: none]
7. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 对药：做药，“做药” means to make or use something as medicine; “对药” does not fit as a verb phrase in this sentence. [rule: none]
8. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农先看到：一个叫神农的男人先看到，This is the character’s first mention, so introduce him with both his name and a short identifying noun phrase. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
9. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 一把花，他想把花：一把花，他想把它，When an object was named very recently and no other object competes with it, use a pronoun rather than repeating the noun. [rule: redundancy_delete]
10. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 这个植物：这些植物，No single plant has been identified before this point; the earlier reference is to many plants, so the singular demonstrative noun phrase is unclear. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
11. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 神农先看到很多病人：神农先看到了很多病人，This is a completed event in the narrative, so use “了” after the resultative verb. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
12. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 他们吃很多能做药的植物：他们吃了很多能做药的植物，Their eating is presented as a completed earlier action connected to their illness, so it needs “了”. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: “对药”不能表示“用来做药”，而“能做药的植物”是正确的名词短语。
“植物对药”中的“对药”搭配错误，“能做药的植物”正确。
“他们吃的植物”中“他们”应直接作“吃”的主语，不能加第一个“的”。
“让”后应接动作或结果，“病人”是名词，改为“生病”正确。
“特别是毒”不能这样描述植物的性质，“特别有毒”语法和词义都正确。
原文片段从宾语中间开始且“对药”错误，改后的名词短语“ 一种可以做药、他们可以吃的植物”正确。
这里“对药”不是可用的动词搭配，“做药”正确。
神农首次出现需要作简短介绍，但改后的片段仍在“看到”后截断，不能独立成句。
刚提到“一把花”后应使用“它”，但改后仍截在“把它”处，缺少后面的谓语。
前文只提到很多植物，未确定某一株植物，所以“这个植物”指代不清，“这些植物”正确。
叙事中的“看到”是完成事件，应为“看到了”，但改后仍未按首次提及规则介绍神农。
病人吃植物是已经完成、并导致生病的事件，应该用“吃了”。
